qbit_restore_summed_floor_testnet4_own_s.message: The signature counter for the account at derivation index $1 was not restored. $2 $3 Testnet4 and Regtest share this counter, and together these counts reach the $4-signature warning threshold. The wallet refuses a counter that high, so signing stays locked; receiving still works. Most of the count comes from the Testnet4 explorer, which cannot be turned off here. Retry later; if it keeps reporting this count, use the qbit Core recovery descriptors on the Secret Recovery Phrase screen to reach the funds. Alternatively, stop the local Regtest service, or turn off Local Regtest in Advanced Settings: a retry then restores the Testnet4 count alone, which is itself close to the threshold and can never be lowered.
